CustomField.formula:
if(Text(Status__c )="Awaiting Client Review", "0", "")& if(Text(Status__c )="Need to Scope", "A4 On Hold", "")& if(Order__c>0, Text( Order__c ) & " | ", "")& Case(Text(Status__c ), "On Hold", "A5 On Hold", "Awaiting Client Review", "A1 Deployed", "Wait 4 Slack Field Synch", "A1 Waiting", "Recurring", "A6 Recurring", "In Progress", "A1 In Progress", if( Due_Date__c < TODAY() , "A2 Overdue", if( CEILING( ( Due_Date__c - DATE( YEAR( Due_Date__c ), 1, 1) + 1) / 7) = CEILING( ( TODAY()- DATE( YEAR( TODAY()), 1, 1) + 1) / 7) , "A3 This Week", if( CEILING( ( Due_Date__c - DATE( YEAR( Due_Date__c ), 1, 1) + 1) / 7) = 1+CEILING( ( TODAY()- DATE( YEAR( TODAY()), 1, 1) + 1) / 7) , "A4 Next Week", if( CEILING( ( Due_Date__c - DATE( YEAR( Due_Date__c ), 1, 1) + 1) / 7) > 1+CEILING( ( TODAY()- DATE( YEAR( TODAY()), 1, 1) + 1) / 7) , "A5 Future",
"No Due Date"))))) & " "& Text(Year(Due_Date__c ))&if(Month(Due_Date__c )<10, "0"&Text(Month(Due_Date__c )), Text(Month(Due_Date__c )))&if(Day(Due_Date__c )<10, "0"&Text(Day(Due_Date__c )),Text(Day(Due_Date__c )))
CustomField.label: DC Sort Grouping
